The letter {{AurB|k}} was the eleventh letter of the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] alphabet. It was pronounced "krill," and was equivalent to /K/ in the [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]].<ref name="Written Word">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>

Uses:
*[[Bunker Krill]], an underground bunker on [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]]
